title: 第29章 人心诡蜮
content_zh:
厉宏生又伏到狗洞前，叫道：“师嫂，你放我们出来，我兄弟为你取那姓闵的小杂种性命！”闵嘉庚听他出言不逊，提起脚来往他屁股上踢去。王万户拉住他手臂向后一扯，这一踢顿时落空。王万户低声说：“大伙须同舟共济，自己人莫吵，要先想法子出去。”心想：“只要温老太肯放厉氏兄弟，便有脱身之机。”

    却听温老太说：“小杂种的性命早已在我手中，何必要你假惺惺相助？再过一两个小时，你们人人都成焦炭。哈哈，这里面没一个好人。姓闵的小杂种、岳老板，厅上好凉快吧？”

    岳胜皱眉不答。温老太又枭啼般笑了几声，叫道：“岳老板，你的女儿我会好好照料她，你放心，我给她找一千个一万个男人。”她这句话，显是说要将他女儿折磨后卖入窑子。岳胜心如刀割，他年纪已大，对自己性命倒不怎么顾惜，只担心独生爱女落在外面，痛受这恶毒老婆子折磨，必定苦不堪言。

    厉宏生站起身来，在兄弟耳边说了几句话，厉宏明点了点头。厉宏生向王万户拱了拱手说：“王主任，咱们同在难中，兄弟可有句不中听的言语。”王万户拉着闵嘉庚的手，说道：“一切全凭吩咐。可是要伸手加害这小兄弟，却万万办不到。”王万户见厉氏兄弟交头接耳，已知二人为了活命，想先杀闵嘉庚，再向温老太求情。

    厉宏生为他一言点破了心事，脸带杀气，厉声说：“王主任，温老太的对头只这孩子一人。冤有头，债有主！大伙犯不着一起陪个孩子做鬼。”他向众人逐一望去，问道：“各位说冤是不冤？”李云立即接口说：“不错！除了这孩子，大伙跟这件事全没牵连。”厉宏生问：“岳老板，你怎么说？”岳胜自忖温老太与己有仇，未必能放过自己三人，但眼前情势危急异常，只有设法脱身先说，闵嘉庚是死是活，原也不放在心上，便说：“厉老总说得是，此事原与旁人无涉。”

    厉宏生说：“赵掌门，你来赶这趟浑水，那更加犯不着。姓魏的已经烧死，你与陈家小妹妹的仇已经报了。”赵安全觉得他的话有理，不过心中极感王万户之情，实不便公然与他作对，劝说：“不是兄弟不顾义气，倘是你王主任……”

    王万户厉声喝道：“你们有六个，我们只两人。咱们倒先瞧瞧，是姓王姓闵的先死呢，还是你们姓厉姓李的先亡！”说着挡在闵嘉庚身前，神威凛凛。他平时面目慈祥，说话温和，心肠又极软，但面临生死关头，“仁侠”二字却顾得极紧，这几句话说得斩钉截铁，竟不留半分余地。

    众人一来忌他武功了得，二来又觉自己贪生怕死，迹近无义小人，倒也不敢一拥而上动手。但一个人到了生死之际，面目全露，委实半点假借不得。各人只觉脚底越来越热，再也站立不住，都拖了一张板凳或椅子，踏在上面。厉宏明紫金刀一扬，叫道：“王主任，兄弟今日要得罪了！”左手向李云、岳胜、周银兵一招手，喝道：“并肩子上啊！”他知赵安全决不能与王万户为敌，但己方五人敌他一老一小，也大有可胜之机。五人武器纷纷出手，只待王万户身子一动，便同时砍杀出去。

    这番只要动上手，势必人人拼命，厅中越来越热，多挨一刻，便多一分危险。

    闵嘉庚心想：“只为我一人，却陪上这几个人。厉氏兄弟等死不足惜，王主任是**的英雄好汉，如何能让他为我而死？这几人拥过来，纵然王主任和我将他们杀了，我们仍是难逃性命。瞧来只有我死在温老太手里，才救得王主任的性命。”见厉氏兄弟跃跃欲动，只没一人敢先发难，心念已决，朗声说：“大家且莫动手。”俯身将头钻出狗洞，叫道：“温老太，我在这里不动，你发镖打死我吧！快开门放王主任出去！”

    温老太仰天大笑，从怀中掏出金钱镖，叫道：“宏伟，今日我给你亲手报仇！”右手一扬，一枚喂有剧毒的金钱镖对准闵嘉庚的面门急射过去。

    闵嘉庚眼见金光闪动，金钱镖向自己眉心急射过来，双目一闭，心想：“老巫婆将我打死，遂了心愿。她与王主任无仇，自会放他出来。”就在此时，突觉右足被人扯动，身子向后激射。他睁开眼来，身在半空，当即左臂长出，在柱上一抹，轻轻落下，只见王万户手中接了一枝金钱镖，原来又是他救了自己性命。

    厉宏生见闵嘉庚舍身救人，王万户竟从中阻挠，不禁大怒，叫道：“姓王的，大丈夫恩怨分明，此事原本与你我无干。他自愿就死，又要你横加插手干嘛？”

    王万户微笑不答，转头向闵嘉庚说：“小兄弟，适才你脑袋钻出了狗洞外，是么？”闵嘉庚说：“是啊。”见他神情镇定，笑容可掬，似乎已有了脱身之计，说道：“王主任，请你吩咐。”王万户说：“脑袋是硬的，无法缩小，肩膀与身子却是软的。”闵嘉庚立时领悟，叫道：“是了，脑袋既钻得出，身子便也钻得出。”当即脱下棉袄，裹成一团，顶在头上。身上瘦了，易于钻出，头顶棉袄，可挡温老太喂毒的金钱镖。

    王万户说：“你且退后，我给你开路。”周银兵叫道：“不行，你这么胖，怎钻得出去？”王万户哈哈一笑，不去理他，俯下身子，右手一扬处，一枚袖箭从狗洞中激射而出，只听外面有人大声呼痛，叫道：“脚，脚，我的脚！”显是他的脚给袖箭打中了。王万户左手微动，又将温老太的金钱镖发了出去。

    这一次外面却无动静，想是各人均已避开。有人叫道：“快，快把狗洞堵死。”温老太喝道：“不许堵，我要听他们烫死时的呼叫。大家避在一旁便是，暗器能拐弯么？”王万户双手连扬，十余枚暗器接连射出，去势劲急异常，都射出十丈以外。

    发到将近二十枚，他左手在闵嘉庚背后轻轻一推。闵嘉庚向前一扑，先将棉袄送了出去。温老太早已防到这招，火光下见黑黝黝的一团从狗洞中钻出，紫金刀呼的一刀砍下来，正中棉袄，但觉着刀之处软绵绵的，心知不对，急忙提刀。闵嘉庚急从狗洞中钻出，右手抢前，手掌翻转，已抓住温老太手腕。

    温老太大叫一声。温文新纵了过来，挥刀向着闵嘉庚头顶砍落。闵嘉庚借劲将温老太的手腕挥去，铛的一响，母子俩双刀相交。这下手法正是王万户适才所授的借力打力功夫，也是他聪明过人，一学即能使用。温文新第二刀复又砍下，这刀劲力好大，正砍在墙基的花岗石上，火星四溅，刀口也卷了起来。闵嘉庚转身打了个旋子，火光中见温老太横刀向自己削来，急使个千斤坠，身子骤落，只听呼的一声，紫金刀从头顶掠过。他足未落地，左掌翻起，以空手夺白刃功夫去夺温老太手中紫金刀。

    温老太见仇人居然死里逃生，眼都红了，紫金刀直上直下，狂斩猛劈。闵嘉庚空手抢攻数招，竟丝毫占不到便宜，但听佣工大声呐喊，烟火里温文新提刀又上。闵嘉庚心想此时厅上已烧得炽热异常，时候稍久，王万户等性命难保，他心中焦急，一双肉掌在两柄大刀间穿来插去，狠命相扑。温家母子也知这一战乃生死存亡之所系，双刀呼呼，绕着闵嘉庚围攻。

    大厅中王万户、厉氏兄弟等八人一起俯耳狗洞旁，倾听闵嘉庚与温家母子相斗。厉氏兄弟虽对闵嘉庚颇为憎恨，但此时却与王万户的心思并无二致，只盼闵嘉庚快些杀败温家母子，打开厅门。厅上热气越来越难熬，桌椅噼啪作响，蜡烛遇热熔尽，顿时黑漆一团。突然火光一旺，却是墙壁上挂着的屏条字画遇热燃烧，但片刻烧尽，接着又伸手不见五指，再过不久，只怕桌椅也要烧着了。

    众人心中急得也如烈火焚烧，却谁也不出声，凝神倾听外面三人相斗之声。
content_en:
Li Hongsheng crouched down in front of the dog hole again and shouted, "Sister-in-law, let us out, and my brother will take the life of that little bastard named Min for you!" Min Jiageng heard his rude words and kicked him in the butt.Wang Wanhu grabbed his arm and pulled him back, and the kick immediately failed.Wang Wanhu said in a low voice: "Everyone must work together in the same boat. Don't quarrel among yourself, and find a way out first." He thought to himself: "As long as Mrs. Wen is willing to let the Li brothers go, there will be a chance to escape."
But I heard Mrs. Wen say: "You little bastard's life is already in my hands, why do you need to pretend to help me? In an hour or two, all of you will be reduced to ashes. Haha, there is no good person here. The little bastard named Min, Boss Yue, is it cool in the hall?"
Yue Sheng frowned and didn't answer.Old Mrs. Wen laughed like an owl a few more times and shouted: "Boss Yue, I will take good care of your daughter. Don't worry, I will find a thousand or ten thousand men for her." Her words clearly meant that she would torture his daughter and sell her to a brothel.Yue Sheng's heart felt like a knife. He was already old and he didn't care much about his own life. He was only worried that his only daughter would be left outside and tortured by this vicious old woman. She would definitely suffer terribly.
Li Hongsheng stood up and said a few words in his brother's ear, and Li Hongming nodded.Li Hongsheng bowed his hands to Wang Wanhu and said, "Director Wang, we are all in the same difficulty. Brother, do you have anything to say that you don't want to hear." Wang Wanhu took Min Jiageng's hand and said, "It all depends on the order. But if you want to harm this little brother, you will never be able to do it." Wang Wanhu saw the Li brothers whispering to each other. It was known that in order to survive, the two wanted to kill Min Jiageng first and then plead with Mrs. Wen.
Li Hongsheng was relieved by what he said, and with a murderous look on his face, he said sternly: "Director Wang, Mrs. Wen's only enemy is this child. Every injustice has its owner, and every debt has its owner! We all can't do it together with a child." He looked at everyone one by one and asked: "Do you think the injustice is unjust?" Li Yun immediately said: "Yes! Except for this child, everyone"Boss Yue, what do you say?"Li Hongsheng asked, "Boss Yue, what do you say?" Yue Sheng thought that Mrs. Wen had a grudge against him, so he might not be able to let the three of him go, but the situation at hand was extremely critical, so he had to find a way to escape first.He didn't care whether Min Jiageng was dead or alive, so he said, "Boss Li is right, this matter has nothing to do with anyone else."
Li Hongsheng said: "Master Zhao, you are here to clear this muddy water. It is even more unreasonable. The person surnamed Wei has been burned to death, and the revenge between you and the little sister of the Chen family has been avenged." Zhao An'an felt that his words were reasonable, but he felt deeply for Wang Wanhu in his heart and could not openly oppose him. He persuaded: "It's not that brothers don't care about loyalty. If it were you, Director Wang..."
Wang Wanhu shouted sternly: "There are six of you, and there are only two of us. Let's see first, whether the one named Wang and Min will die first, or your surname Li and surnamed Li will die first!" As he spoke, he stood in front of Min Jiageng, looking majestic.He usually has a kind face, gentle words, and a very soft heart, but when faced with a life-or-death situation, he pays close attention to the word "benevolent knight". These words are categorical, leaving no room for error.
Firstly, everyone was afraid of his martial arts prowess, and secondly, they felt that he was greedy for life and fearful of death, and that he was approaching a villain with no righteousness, so they did not dare to rush forward and take action.But when a person reaches the moment of life and death, his true identity is revealed, and no pretense can be allowed.Everyone felt that the soles of their feet were getting hotter and hotter, and they could no longer stand, so they all dragged a bench or chair and stepped on it.Li Hongming raised his purple gold sword and shouted: "Director Wang, brothers are going to be offended today!" He waved to Li Yun, Yue Sheng, and Zhou Yinbing with his left hand and shouted: "Come on shoulder to shoulder!" He knew that Zhao An'an could never be an enemy of Wang Wanhu, but with five of his own, one old and one young, he had a good chance of winning.The five people fired their weapons one after another, and as soon as Wang Wanhu moved, they slashed out at the same time.
As soon as this happens, everyone will fight to the death. The hall is getting hotter and hotter. The more time it takes, the more danger it will be.
Min Jiageng thought to himself: "You are only here for me, but you accompany these people. It is not a pity for the Li brothers to wait for death. Director Wang is a heroic man in the country, how can I let him die for me? These people came over, even if Director Wang and I killed them, we still could not escape our lives. It seems that I am the only one who died at the hands of Mrs. Wen.Only then did I save Director Wang's life." Seeing that the Li brothers were eager to take action, no one dared to attack first, and they made a decision and said loudly: "Don't do anything, everyone." He leaned over and dug his head out of the dog hole, shouting: "Mrs.Wen, I won't move here, please shoot me to death!Open the door and let Director Wang out!"
Mrs. Wen looked up to the sky and laughed, took out the money dart from her arms, and shouted: "Hongwei, today I will avenge you with my own hands!" She raised her right hand, and a highly poisonous money dart was aimed at Min Jiageng's face and shot towards him.
Min Jiageng saw the golden light flashing, and the money dart shot toward his eyebrows. He closed his eyes and thought: "The old witch beat me to death, and her wish came true. She has no enmity with Director Wang, so she will let him out." At this moment, he suddenly felt his right foot being pulled by someone, and his body was shot backwards.He opened his eyes and found himself in mid-air. His left arm immediately grew out, touched the pillar, and landed gently. He saw Wang Wanhu receiving a money dart in his hand. It turned out that he had saved his life again.
When Li Hongsheng saw that Min Jiageng sacrificed his life to save others, but Wang Wanhu actually blocked it, he couldn't help being furious and shouted: "The man named Wang has a clear grudge. This matter has nothing to do with you and me. He died of his own volition, why do you want you to interfere?"
Wang Wanhu smiled and didn't answer, turned to Min Jiageng and said, "Little brother, you just got your head out of the dog hole, right?" Min Jiageng said, "Yes." Seeing that he was calm and smiling, he seemed to have a plan to escape, and said, "Director Wang, pleaseOrder." Wang Wanhu said: "The head is hard and cannot be reduced, but the shoulders and body are soft." Min Jiageng immediately understood and shouted: "Yes, if the head can be drilled, the body can also be drilled." He immediately took off his cotton jacket, wrapped it in a ball, and put it on his head.The body is thin, making it easier to get out, and the cotton-padded jacket on the head can block the money darts fed by Mrs. Wen.
Wang Wanhu said, "Stand back, and I will open a way for you." Zhou Yinbing shouted, "No, you are so fat, how can you get out?" Wang Wanhu laughed, ignored him, leaned down, raised his right hand, and a sleeve arrow shot out from the dog hole. He heard someone outside shouting in pain, shouting: "Foot, foot, my foot!" Apparently his foot was hit by the sleeve arrow.Wang Wanhu moved his left hand slightly and sent out Mrs. Wen's money dart again.
This time there was no movement outside, I think everyone had stayed away.Someone shouted: "Quickly, block the dog hole." Old Mrs. Wen shouted: "Don't block it, I want to listen to their cries when they are scalded to death. Everyone just stay aside. Can the hidden weapon turn?" Wang Wanhu raised his hands and fired more than ten hidden weapons one after another. The castration was extremely fast, and they all shot out ten feet away.
When nearly twenty coins were issued, he gently pushed Min Jiageng behind with his left hand.Min Jiageng pounced forward and sent the cotton-padded jacket out first.Mrs. Wen had already been on guard against this move. Under the firelight, she saw a dark mass emerging from the dog's hole. She cut it down with a roar of her purple gold knife, hitting the cotton-padded jacket in the middle. However, she felt that the place where the knife was cut was soft. She knew something was wrong and hurriedly raised the knife.Min Jiageng hurriedly emerged from the dog hole, grabbed the front with his right hand, turned his palm over, and already grabbed Mrs. Wen's wrist.
Mrs. Wen shouted.Wen Wenxin came over and slashed Min Jiageng's head with his knife.Min Jiageng used his strength to wave away Mrs. Wen's wrist, and with a clang, the mother and son's swords crossed.This technique was exactly what Wang Wanhu was taught just now, and he was also very smart and could use it as soon as he learned it.Wen Wenxin struck again with his second knife. This knife was so powerful that it hit the granite at the base of the wall. Sparks flew everywhere and the knife edge curled up.Min Jiageng turned around and made a spin. In the light of the fire, he saw Mrs. Wen slashing at him with a sword. She made a sudden move and fell suddenly. With a roar, the purple gold sword passed over her head.Before he even touched the ground, he turned up his left palm and used his bare-handed hand-to-hand kung fu to snatch the purple gold knife from Mrs. Wen's hand.
Mrs. Wen's eyes turned red when she saw that her enemy had escaped from death. She slashed wildly with her purple gold sword straight up and down.Min Jiageng attacked several times with his bare hands, but could not gain any advantage. However, he heard the servant shouting loudly, and Wen Wenxin raised the sword again in the fireworks.Min Jiageng thought that the hall was already extremely hot. After a while, the lives of Wang Wanhu and others were in danger. He was anxious in his heart, and thrust his fleshy palms between the two swords, fighting fiercely.The Wen family's mother and son also knew that this battle was a matter of life and death, so they surrounded Min Jiageng with their swords whirring.
In the hall, eight people, including Wang Wanhu and the Li brothers, were leaning over the dog hole, listening to the fight between Min Jiageng and the Wen family's mother and son.Although the Li brothers hated Min Jiageng, they had the same thoughts as Wang Wanhu at this time. They only hoped that Min Jiageng would quickly kill the Wen family's mother and son and open the hall door.The heat in the hall became more and more unbearable, the tables and chairs crackled, the candles melted due to the heat, and it suddenly became pitch black.Suddenly there was a bright fire, but the calligraphy and paintings hanging on the wall were burned by the heat. But they burned out in a moment, and then they were invisible again. Soon, the tables and chairs would also be burned.
Everyone's hearts were burning with anxiety, but no one said a word, listening intently to the sound of the three people fighting outside.
title_en: Chapter 29 The human heart is treacherous
